description: Figure 1 is a line plot that illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across different layers within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model for four languages: English (en), Spanish (es), Bengali (bn), and Greek (el). The x-axis represents the layers, ranging from 0 to 21, with a logarithmic scale indicating the layer number. The y-axis represents the cosine similarity of HSAs, with values ranging from 0 to 1. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different language, with distinct colors and markers for easy differentiation. The English line (en) is depicted in red, the Spanish line (es) in blue, the Bengali line (bn) in green, and the Greek line (el) in purple. The lines show varying degrees of similarity across the layers, with the English line generally displaying the highest similarity, particularly in the middle and last few layers. The other three language lines show similar patterns but with lower overall similarity compared to the English line.
